== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[One Beautiful Thing (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-47-One_Beautiful_Thing.png]]) shows the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-46-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-onebeautifulthing-pre.gif]]) show PC-E2.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Lose 1 Force to take Black Leader into hand from Reserve Deck (or retrieve); reshuffle. OR During battle where you have no Dark Jedi or droids and only two participating cards with ability (a male and a female), add one destiny to total power (and attrition against you = 0).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_46</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
